name: LOLIN S2 Mini
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) S2 Mini v1.0.0: 34.3 x 25.4 mm, bare ESP32-S2FN4R2 (4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM), USB-C, PCB trace antenna. Two pin rows per side - the outer rows match the LOLIN D1 mini footprint, so D1 mini shields fit; the inner rows are drawn as the inboard pad strip here.

No USB-UART bridge: flashing and the serial console run over the S2's native USB (GPIO19/20, wired only to the USB-C connector). If the firmware wedges, hold BOOT (GPIO0, not broken out) and tap RST to enter the ROM downloader.

Native UART0 (GPIO43/44) is not broken out. The Arduino defaults are TX=GPIO39, RX=GPIO37 (via the GPIO matrix), I2C SDA=GPIO33 / SCL=GPIO35, SPI SCK=7 / MISO=9 / MOSI=11 / SS=12 - matching the D1 mini shield positions.

headers.surfacePadCaption: inner pin rows - real through-hole header pads inboard of the D1-mini-footprint outer rows

15.label: LED
15.note: Blue onboard LED, active HIGH (unlike the D1 mini's active-low LED).

18.note: Has a 10 k pullup to 3.3 V on the board (idles HIGH); also DAC2. Sits at the D1 mini D3 shield position.

33.label: SDA
33.note: Arduino default I2C SDA - the D1 mini D2/SDA shield position.

35.label: SCL
35.note: Arduino default I2C SCL - the D1 mini D1/SCL shield position.

37.label: RX
37.note: Arduino default RX via the GPIO matrix (native U0RXD GPIO44 is not broken out).

39.label: TX
39.note: Arduino default TX via the GPIO matrix (native U0TXD GPIO43 is not broken out).
